items.heading: Check the Marksheet Before Planning
items.text: Check the marksheet before planning around any exam. Whether Mathematics appears as a real Class 12 subject decides whether JEE, most BSc Computer Science (Hons) seats, and most biomedical engineering routes are open. Verify this fact first, not last.

items.heading: Ask Which Part
items.text: Ask which part of the combination the student actually enjoyed. A student who liked the biology practicals more than the Python programs is signalling a different path than one who found the CS periods the highlight of the week.

items.heading: Ask What Real Work Bioinformatics,
items.text: Ask what real work bioinformatics, health informatics, or data-in-healthcare involves. If the family cannot describe the actual daily work beyond "something with computers and biology," the decision is still being made on a label, not a plan.

items.heading: Ask How the Family Will
items.text: Ask how the family will judge success beyond the first job title. A bachelor's degree in this space is often a starting point, not a finish line. Budget time and money for a possible master's, certification, or skill-building phase after it.
